about: Al Kharid, the Misthalin roadmap's Al Kharid piece. Step 5: Chancellor Hassan (4285) in the throne room and Osman (4286) outside the palace on 2004Scape's tiles, standing still (guessed); Prince Ali (prince_ali_palace, 11645, shown as Prince Ali once Prince Ali Rescue is done) in the throne room by Hassan, a tile the Wiki doesn't give (guessed). Step 4: Ellis the tanner (ellis_tanner, 3231) in his shop north of the furnace, indoors and wandering 5 as the shop keepers do (guessed), Karim (kebab_seller, 2877) in his kitchen north of the bank and the Silk trader (2873) at his stall, on 2004Scape's tiles, standing still (guessed). Step 3: the shop keepers, on 2004Scape's tiles (maps m51_49 and m51_50), indoors and wandering 5 as Lumbridge's keepers do (guessed), the Gem trader at his stall standing still (guessed); Ali Morrisane, whom 2004Scape doesn't have, by his stall and The Feud's quest icon in the market's north-east (3304, 3211, guessed from the 241 map's stall and icon). Step 2: the bank's five Bankers behind their booths (x 3267), kharidbanker1 (3090) and kharidbanker2 (3091) as 2004Scape's map m51_49 places them; the Wiki counts 5. Step 1: the toll gate's four Border Guards, borderguard1 (4287) on the Lumbridge side and borderguard2 (4288) on the Al Kharid side, two each side of the gate (3268, 3227 to 3228). Tiles from 2004Scape's map m51_50 (its npc 925 borderguard1 and 926 borderguard2), checked against the 241 map floor and the Wiki's Toll gate map. They stand still, as 2004Scape has them (it only turns them now and then; left out, guessed).
